name: OpenRouter Usage
author: Chris Rueber
description: OpenRouter key usage in the Omarchy bar: spend against the key's own limit, or spend only when the key has no limit, with one previous cycle kept locally for comparison.

barWidget.description: Bar meter for the OpenRouter key limit and current cycle spend, switching to a dollar amount when the key has no limit or runs above the previous cycle. The popup shows reset, previous cycle, and account credits.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask OpenRouter for the key's limit and spend. Five minutes is the default.

schema.label: Node executable
schema.description: Optional. Path to node for the small OpenRouter helper; empty finds node in your login shell PATH.

schema.label: OpenCode auth file
schema.description: Optional. OpenCode credential file with the openrouter key; empty uses ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json. OPENROUTER_API_KEY overrides this.

schema.label: Show account credits in the popup
schema.description: Adds the account credit balance reported by OpenRouter to the popup.

schema.label: Over-previous colour
schema.description: Slightly yellow bar/text when the current cycle is over the previous completed cycle.

schema.label: 90% colour
schema.description: Orange bar/text at 90% of the limit.

schema.label: Limit colour
schema.description: Red at the limit; empty uses the theme urgent colour.

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Optional shell command; empty opens the OpenRouter activity page.
